name: Manyfold
description: Manyfold is an open source, self-hosted web application for managing a collection of 3D models, particularly focused on 3D printing.

author: linuxserver.io

form_fields.label: DATABASE_URL
form_fields.hint: Database connection URL. For sqlite use sqlite3:/config/manyfold.sqlite3. For postgres or mariadb use <scheme>://<username>:<password>@<hostname>:<port>/<db name> where <scheme> is postgresql or mysql2. Special characters in username/password must be URL encoded.

form_fields.label: REDIS_URL
form_fields.hint: Redis/Valkey database URL in redis://<hostname>:<port>/<db number> format.

form_fields.label: SECRET_KEY_BASE
form_fields.hint: Browser session and database encryption key. If unset a random one will be generated on init, the database is locked to this key.
